tasks.subject: Task 1: Theme resolution
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A configured theme name reaches every page object, overridable per suite or scenario.

**Files:**
- Modify: src/Tests/TestsSuite.php, src/Traits/ImportPage.php, src/Pages/CommonPage.php
- Test: tests/Unit/Pages/ThemeSelectorsTest.php

**Verify:** vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite Unit --filter ThemeSelectors

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Tests/TestsSuite.php", "src/Traits/ImportPage.php", "src/Pages/CommonPage.php", "tests/Unit/Pages/ThemeSelectorsTest.php"], "verifyCommand": "vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite Unit --filter ThemeSelectors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["PRESTAFLOW_THEME populates globals['THEME'], default classic", "params['theme'] overrides the global like params['locale'] does", "getTheme() returns classic when nothing is set", "no static state: theme read from $this->globals"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: The theme merge tier
tasks.description:
**Goal:** getSelectors() merges <theme>.json over the base map, project file beating library file, warning when a named theme has no file.

**Files:**
- Modify: src/Pages/CommonPage.php (getSelectors), src/Traits/ImportPage.php
- Test: tests/Unit/Pages/ThemeSelectorsTest.php

**Verify:** vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite Unit --filter ThemeSelectors

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Pages/CommonPage.php", "src/Traits/ImportPage.php", "tests/Unit/Pages/ThemeSelectorsTest.php"], "verifyCommand": "vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite Unit --filter ThemeSelectors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["src/Themes/<theme>.json merged over the base map", "Tests/Themes/<theme>.json wins over the library file", "order: base -> library theme -> project theme -> locale selectors -> customs", "classic needs no file and no branch", "a named theme with no file warns once and keeps the base map"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Audit the 63 selectors
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Each of the 11 FrontOffice pages holds the exact Classic selector; src/Themes/hummingbird.json holds the Hummingbird one where they differ. No unions left.

**Files:**
- Create: src/Themes/hummingbird.json
- Modify: the 11 FrontOffice page objects

**Verify:** covered by Task 4 — no unit test can tell a right selector from a wrong one

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Themes/hummingbird.json", "src/Pages/v9/FrontOffice"], "verifyCommand": "grep -rn \"' =>\" src/Pages/v9/FrontOffice --include=Page.php | grep -E \"=> *'[^']*, *[.#\\[]\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["every selector checked against both themes", "Classic form in the page, Hummingbird form in the JSON", "no stopgap union selectors remain", "hummingbird.json holds only diverging keys, nested FrontOffice/<Page>"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Validate against both themes
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the audit by running the existing suites against a Hummingbird shop (1) and a Classic shop (2).

**Verify:** every run green, orders confirmed in ps_orders, and the missing-theme warning observed

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Themes/hummingbird.json", "src/Pages/v9/FrontOffice"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/prestaflow run src/Tests/Suites/Scenarios -g opc", "acceptanceCriteria": ["OPC guest + order and Registration pass on shop 1 with THEME=hummingbird", "the same suites pass on shop 2 with THEME=classic", "the scenario-level params['theme'] override demonstrably wins", "a wrong theme warns and fails visibly rather than passing silently"]}
```
